records.observation: Official Wests Tigers squad update confirms Aho will make his NRL debut from the bench after 21 NSW Cup appearances in 2026.
records.macro_effect: No NRL statistical sample exists yet. The absence of first-grade stats is a genuine pre-debut state, not an acquisition defect.
records.source: Wests Tigers official Round 27 squad update

records.observation: Official Wests Tigers update confirms May is due to play his 100th NRL game in Round 27.
records.macro_effect: Milestone is retained as context only; MAYHEM does not infer a performance increase from the milestone itself.
records.source: Wests Tigers official Round 27 squad update

records.observation: Official NRL late mail confirms Yeo has been elevated from the reserves to the interchange after three games out.
records.macro_effect: Improves Penrith middle/spine continuity relative to the earlier squad state; no workload beyond the named role is assumed.

records.observation: Official NRL late mail confirms Kenny will start at hooker in his seventh game of the season.
records.macro_effect: Restores Penrith's primary dummy-half role; return workload remains an uncertainty rather than an assumed positive volume effect.

records.observation: Official NRL game-day late mail confirms Russell moves from the interchange to fullback.
records.macro_effect: Changes Eels backfield organisation and spine linkage immediately before kickoff; no directional performance effect is inferred without stronger role-specific evidence.

records.observation: Official NRL game-day late mail confirms Twidle shifts from fullback to the interchange.
records.macro_effect: Preserves player availability but changes starting role and Eels backfield continuity relative to the prior checkpoint.

records.observation: Official NRL reporting confirms Yeo completed his Round 27 return after three games out. Finals Week 1 selection and workload remain pending the official team list.
records.macro_effect: Positive Penrith middle and leadership continuity signal without assuming Finals Week 1 minutes.

records.observation: Official NRL reporting confirms Kenny started at hooker and completed his Round 27 return. Finals Week 1 selection remains pending the official team list.
records.macro_effect: Positive Penrith dummy-half continuity signal without assuming future workload.

records.observation: Current Finals reporting expects Sorensen to return for Week 1, but he is not treated as selected until the official team list is published.
records.macro_effect: Potential positive Penrith forward continuity; no confidence uplift before selection confirmation.
records.source: Current Finals Week 1 reporting; official team list pending

records.observation: Current Finals reporting expects Tedesco back after Round 27 rest/management. At the official Finals launch he identified completion, field position and Daly Cherry-Evans' kicking control as the Round 24 template against Penrith.
records.macro_effect: Makes the Roosters' Round 24 win a more representative structural matchup reference than their deliberately weakened Round 27 side.

records.observation: Current Finals reporting expects Cherry-Evans to return after Round 27 rest. Tedesco specifically identified his kicking control as part of the Roosters' successful Round 24 template against Penrith.
records.macro_effect: Potential restoration of first-choice kicking and field-position control; selection remains unconfirmed until the official list.

records.observation: Current Finals reporting expects Radley to return after being absent from the deliberately weakened Round 27 configuration.
records.macro_effect: Potential restoration of senior middle continuity; no directional effect beyond that until selection is verified.
records.source: Current Finals Week 1 reporting; official team list pending

records.observation: Current Finals reporting has Crichton as a possible Week 1 return. He is not treated as available or selected until official confirmation.
records.macro_effect: Potential Roosters edge-strength restoration; uncertainty retained.
records.source: Current Finals Week 1 reporting; official team list pending

records.observation: Current reporting indicates Walker is unlikely to return before a potential preliminary final.
records.macro_effect: Limits the probability of a full-strength Roosters halves configuration in Week 1, subject to official updates.

records.observation: Current club/Finals reporting confirms Aitken will miss the rest of the season with a fractured scapula.
records.macro_effect: Reduces Rabbitohs edge continuity for the elimination final.

records.observation: Duncan is expected to return after being rested in Round 27; official Finals selection is still pending.
records.macro_effect: Potentially restores some Rabbitohs forward continuity.

records.observation: Crossland has publicly stated he will play after minor knee surgery, but official Week 1 selection is still pending.
records.macro_effect: Positive Newcastle spine and rotation continuity signal.

records.observation: Manuleleua remains in rehabilitation following an elbow injury; Week 1 availability is not confirmed.
records.macro_effect: Newcastle edge-forward continuity remains partially unresolved.

records.observation: Ford is expected back for the qualifying final, subject to official selection.
records.macro_effect: Potential positive Warriors forward continuity.

records.observation: NRL casualty reporting says Halasima, who missed Round 27 with an ankle injury, is expected to return for the opening final.
records.macro_effect: Potential restoration of Warriors backline continuity.

records.observation: Watene-Zelezniak remains an outside chance under current reporting; no Week 1 availability is assumed.
records.macro_effect: Residual Warriors outside-back uncertainty remains.

records.observation: NRL casualty reporting says Cobbo missed Round 27 with an ankle injury and is expected to be available after finals freshening, but official selection is pending.
records.macro_effect: Potential restoration of Dolphins outside-back strike and continuity.

records.observation: NRL casualty reporting says Nikorima was managed with hamstring tightness in Round 27 and was given a chance to freshen up ahead of finals.
records.macro_effect: Potential improvement in Dolphins spine continuity if officially selected.

records.observation: Official NRL reporting records Tabuai-Fidow scoring two tries and running 261 metres in the Dolphins' 24-20 Round 27 win over the Titans.
records.macro_effect: Recent high-volume running and scoring output strengthens the Dolphins attacking counter-case, without establishing causation or changing the current Warriors selection by itself.

records.observation: NRL.com reports Cronulla is preparing to welcome back the 2026 try-assist leader for the elimination final. This is not treated as official team-list confirmation.
records.macro_effect: Material positive Sharks spine-continuity signal pending official selection.

records.observation: Official NRL judiciary reporting lists a Grade 3 Careless High Tackle charge with plea TBC and a 2-3 match penalty range.
records.macro_effect: Sharks centre-depth risk remains unresolved.

records.observation: Official NRL judiciary reporting confirms Cotter pleaded not guilty to a Grade 2 Careless High Tackle charge and will front the judiciary Tuesday night. If found guilty he receives a two-match suspension.
records.macro_effect: Material Cowboys middle-continuity uncertainty remains active until the judiciary outcome is verified.
